MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #18
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 4 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 7
   C. 10
   D. 6

2. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 24
   C. 144
   D. 156

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 49
   C. 43
   D. 31

4. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 2
   C. 49
   D. 14

5. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 11
   C. 122
   D. 22

6. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)

   C. 13
   D. 169

7. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 9

8. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 15
   C. 13
   D. 7

9. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 8
   C. 0
   D. 16

10. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

11. Solve for x: x + 9 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 9
   C. 9
   D. 18

12. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

13. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 0
   C. 16
   D. 64

14. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.025
   C. 0.25
   D. 0.205

15. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

16. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 49
   C. 50
   D. 7

17. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 28
   C. 11
   D. 29

18. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 37
   C. 5
   D. 13

19. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x ≥ 0 only
   C. x = 5
   D. x < 5

20. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 26
   C. 5
   D. 25

21. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 9
   C. 1
   D. 20

22. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 3/4
   C. 1/2
   D. 2/3

23. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

24. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 24

25. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 90
   D. 81

26. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 12
   C. 1
   D. 7

27. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 24

28. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 12
   C. 4
   D. 33

29. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

30. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 24.5
   B. 8
   C. 7
   D. 49

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
